name: Summoning Shadra
summary: Master Gadrin gives you a parchment to read at the altar of Shadra'Alor, deep in the Witherbark realm of the Hinterlands, to summon Shadra the spider god. Her venom is then to be carried to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

sections.title: Call of the Spider God
sections.body: Gadrin's parchment is meant to be read at Shadra'Alor's altar, deep within the Witherbark realm of the Hinterlands. Doing so calls up Shadra the spider god. She must be defeated there, and her venom taken to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

faq.q: Who provides the parchment to summon Shadra?
faq.answer: Master Gadrin gives you the parchment.
In the Hinterlands, at Shadra'Alor's altar, well inside the Witherbark realm.

faq.q: Who receives the venom once Shadra is defeated?
aliases: who do i turn the venom into
